perhentian-turtle-project.text: Not a registered charity on its own site: run by Fuze Ecoteer Outdoor Adventures Sdn Bhd (a private company), so donations would not be tax-deductible and there is no published registration.

kudat-turtle-conservation-society.text: No 2024-2026 news or activity found; most recent dated coverage is 2017. Website blocks automated reading, so current status unconfirmed.

malaysian-nature-society.text: Executive Director I. S. Shanmugaraj Subramaniam's tenure ended July 2026; MNS gave no reason and appointed an acting ED. No controversy reported.

furrykids-safehaven.text: March 2025: dispute with private landowner over sole access road to Seremban shelter; state reps sponsored RM18,000 for a reserve road (Malaysiakini, The Sun). Not a misconduct issue but an operational risk.

spca-penang.text: Feb 2025: SPCA Penang admitted dumping about 10 dead cats in a Jelutong roadside bin, citing loss of council incinerator access; DVS found no evidence of cruelty but said investigation continues (Malay Mail, TRP).

nasom.text: No controversy found. Website security issue: the NASOM homepage contained injected gambling and casino spam text and links when fetched on 2026-10-17. Tell NASOM before linking to the site.

rumah-kids.text: No controversy found. Website security issue: the Rumah KIDS pages contained injected spam (a 'traditionrolex.com' link and a casino advert) when fetched on 2026-10-17. Confirm bank details with the organisation directly.

nkf-malaysia.text: IRB revoked 44(6) tax-exempt status in Aug 2019 after an audit (NKF said no misuse of funds was found). NKF won judicial review; Court of Appeal dismissed IRB appeal on leave (1 Apr 2024) and High Court quashed the revocation (28 Nov 2024). Whether IRB appealed further not found.

national-cancer-society-malaysia.text: Printed 44(6) approval period ended 31 Dec 2025; no renewed reference shown on site. Homepage contains injected links to gambling/supplement sites (possible site compromise).

womens-aid-organisation.text: March-April 2024 governance dispute: seven exco members resigned, executive director Sumitra Visvanathan was suspended and left, claiming the new exco was unlawful; WAO said appointments were registered with RoS and it was not under RoS probe. Also: WAO website pages contain injected gambling/adult links (possible site compromise).

malaysian-relief-agency.text: Website looks compromised: impact counters show 0 and an unrelated pharmacy advert is embedded. Alert them before linking.

peace-harmony-home-penang.text: No website, no verified social accounts and no published office contact. Confirm directly before onboarding.

kasih-turtle-conservation-project.text: No registration number, website or named operator found online yet. Confirm who runs the hatchery and request its registration certificate before verification.
